statement: A durable restarted node with canonical startup authority does not enter the cold-formation operation-ledger barrier solely because previously restarted members are temporarily pre-ready; it reaches READY through the existing durable-rejoin path, while fresh simultaneous formation remains fail-closed on concentrated or incomplete operation-ledger evidence.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Before changing production code, add a deterministic red-on-revert discriminator at the existing operation-ledger formation barrier: the same snapshot with two pre-ready canonical peers releases durable rejoin without polling the barrier, while fresh join still latches and reaches the existing typed timeout when ledger evidence remains concentrated or incomplete.

Reuse startupMode, the existing ready-signal path, and awaitOperationLedgerFormationBarrier. Do not add a readiness, recovery, formation, admission, or operation-ledger owner, and do not create an alternate ready-heartbeat path.

Fresh simultaneous formation must retain the current fail-closed barrier, typed timeout, discovery window, replica-spread requirement, and operation-drain requirement. The correction may change only whether durable reentry is eligible to latch the cold-formation barrier.

Use the existing durable-rejoin startup identity rather than inferring reentry from peer counts, reachability, cache contents, ready leases, or operation-ledger absence. Unknown or fresh startup modes must not inherit the durable-rejoin exemption.

Do not raise the two-minute restart or formation budgets, lower workload, weaken canonical-authority or ready-lease checks, bypass operation-ledger consistency, or reinterpret bootstrap reachability as join completion.

Use the existing architecture/TLA contract gate to check the temporal cohort-latch and lifecycle boundary if an adjacent model can express it. Extend a model only when the deterministic discriminator proves a transition-semantics gap; Alloy is not required unless the correction changes owner or cohort cardinality rather than startup-state eligibility.

After deterministic and model closure on one exact clean commit, run one N=1 rolling-restart diagnostic with the unchanged workload and failure schedule. Do not spend another N=15 certification window in this child Quest; return the exact N=1 result to the parent for the representative decision.
